hooks.description: Emit a banner when the dispatch catalog is missing, empty, unparseable, or stale relative to source files.
Auto-rebuild the dispatch catalog when any source file (skills/**/SKILL.md or agents/*.md) has a newer mtime than the catalog, or when the catalog was built for a different project.
Record an agent_dispatch event to dispatch-log.jsonl whenever an Agent tool is invoked.
Detect Agent dispatch that bypasses the dispatch skill; write bypass or stale_dispatch drift events to router-drift.jsonl.
Scan the completed session transcript for routing-quality drift events and append them to router-drift.jsonl.
